points.problem: Shared public entity links are the commercial first impression and must expose identity, hierarchy, image, producer/production relationship and primary action immediately.
points.acceptance: Both public views are visually self-explanatory on mobile without authentication and use current brand identity.

points.problem: Create/edit/view parity is a global acceptance requirement.
points.acceptance: Entity identity, information hierarchy, media and actions remain recognizable across create/edit/view.

points.problem: Role recognition must be explicit for participant, artist, producer/promoter and user surfaces.
points.acceptance: Role and relationship to events/productions are visually clear without relying on generic profile chrome.

points.problem: Item and ticket/pass presentation spans public and authenticated surfaces and needs consistent entity context.
points.acceptance: Every item/pass clearly identifies its event/production context, image and primary action.

points.problem: Global acceptance forbids decorative opacity/transparency, Bootstrap-default regressions and off-brand blue/white surfaces.
points.acceptance: Shared tokens/primitives enforce current logo palette, opaque surfaces, AA contrast, legible typography and no horizontal overflow.

points.problem: Public production has a canonical public route while /production/:id is protected; cross-links must never send shared visitors to the protected route.
points.acceptance: All public production cards/share links resolve to /production/:slug/public or /agenda/:slug as appropriate.

points.problem: City-specific discovery routes must not visually or conceptually imply Cutinapp is limited to one city/country.
points.acceptance: Location is a filter/context, while product language and navigation remain global.

points.problem: Blog is public presentation content and must connect visibly to event, production, artist and discovery surfaces rather than act as an isolated content silo.
points.acceptance: Relevant entity links/cards use shared visual language and lead into the ecosystem.
